name: Exterior Trim Power Wash
intent: Low-pressure power wash to remove chalk, dirt, mildew. Handles chalk removal (no chalk-binding primer needed). Post-wash dry verification.
doctrine: Power wash removes chalk, dirt, mildew, and loose debris. This IS the chalk removal step — no chalk-binding primer exists. Low pressure (under 1500 PSI on wood) to avoid fiber damage. Dry time verification prevents moisture trapping under primer.
